items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: Ed Straughan is a preacher. He lived near now. He had a church he played.

ctx.x: Oh, you're sanctified now? No, I ain't. I ain't got out. You got out, but you were sanctified. Yeah. Did you ever play your, your fiddling church or your guitar? Yeah, I saw. No, not the biggest place I played. Which, which did you play? Which box did you play in church? Your guitar or your fiddle? I played my fiddle.
I had another partner play my guitar.
Ed Straughan is a preacher. He lived near now. He had a church he played. He got off. Come on in.
